title: AURA overview
description: Runs, LLM calls and tokens, MCP tools, orchestration and HITL for aura webserver, from its /metrics endpoint (OpenTelemetry GenAI and MCP semantic conventions).

panels.title: Runs in flight
panels.description: aura.runs.active: agent runs that have started and not yet ended, every ingress.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Agent runs ended in the dashboard's time range (gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration count, main agents only).

panels.title: Run error ratio
panels.description: Share of runs in range that ended with an error.type (timeout, cancelled, client_disconnect, shutdown, stream_error).

panels.title: LLM calls per run
panels.description: Mean gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls over the range.

panels.title: Tool calls per run
panels.description: Mean gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls over the range.

panels.title: Run duration p95
panels.description: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration p95 over the range, main agents.

panels.title: Runs per second
panels.description: Runs ending per second by agent, ingress (http, a2a, slack) and mode.

panels.title: Run outcomes
panels.description: Runs per second by outcome. `ok` is a run with no error.type.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration, request to final event, main agents.

panels.title: Calls per run
panels.description: Mean LLM calls and tool calls per run.

panels.title: HTTP requests per second
panels.description: http.server.request.duration count. For a streaming completion this ends at the response headers; see Run duration for the whole run.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Provider-billed input tokens in range, cached tokens included (Σ aura.usage).

panels.title: Cache read tokens
panels.description: Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache. Stays empty until a provider reports cache usage.

panels.title: Cache write tokens
panels.description: Input tokens written to the provider's prompt cache. Stays empty until a provider reports cache usage.

panels.title: LLM calls
panels.description: Inference calls in range, every agent and worker.

panels.title: LLM calls per second
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.duration count by agent, provider and model.

panels.title: LLM call duration
panels.description: One inference call, first byte to turn end, by provider and model.

panels.title: LLM errors per second
panels.description: Inference calls that ended in an error (context_overflow, max_depth, cancelled, stream_error).

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Provider-billed tokens per second by agent.

panels.title: Input tokens per call
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.operation.input_tokens: the context each call carried, so growth here is context-window pressure.

panels.title: MCP server connections
panels.description: aura.mcp.server.connected per agent and configured MCP server, as of the last connection attempt.

panels.title: Tools discovered
panels.description: aura.mcp.server.tools: tools listed by each MCP server at connect time.

panels.title: MCP calls per second
panels.description: mcp.client.operation.duration count (tools/call) by server and tool. Workers and single agents alike.

panels.title: MCP call duration
panels.description: Time inside the MCP client call, transport included.

panels.title: MCP errors per second
panels.description: tool_error is a result the server flagged isError; transport_error and cancelled are the client's.

panels.title: Tool executions per second
panels.description: gen_ai.execute_tool.duration count: tool calls as the agent loop sees them, HITL wait and middleware included. Single agents and the coordinator; worker tool calls appear in the MCP panels only.

panels.title: Tool execution errors per second
panels.description: tool_error, tool_call_error or json_error as the result detector classifies them.

panels.title: Routing decisions per second
panels.description: aura.orchestration.routing: direct_answer, orchestrated or clarification, counted at every planning call including continuations.

panels.title: Planning cycles per run
panels.description: Mean aura.orchestration.planning_cycles per orchestrated run.

panels.title: Worker task outcomes per second
panels.description: aura.orchestration.task.duration count by worker and outcome (completed, blocked, agent_timeout, failed).

panels.title: HITL approvals pending
panels.description: aura.hitl.pending: tool calls waiting on a human decision right now.

panels.title: HITL decisions per second
panels.description: aura.hitl.decision.duration count by decision (approved, denied, timeout, cancelled).

panels.title: HITL decision wait
panels.description: Approval request to decision.
